notes: Two polls: NAIA Women's Volleyball Coaches' Top 25 (division NAIA; Biola's division through 2016) and AVCA NCAA Division II Coaches Top 25 (division NCAA DII). One poll series per division; no other polls mixed in.

confidence=primary: the weekly poll release itself (naia.org release/news page or avca.org poll page, live or via web.archive.org), with points and receiving votes where published. confidence=secondary: the poll owner's own week-by-week compilation (NAIA ratings-history PDF; AVCA DII week-by-week xlsx), which gives every ranked team and the release date but no points/receiving votes.
Where a primary release exists it was cross-checked against the compilation; differences are listed in each poll's notes.
team_raw is copied as printed except that trailing first-place-vote counts like '(16)' / '[45]' were moved to first_place_votes.
postseason_final=true only for polls released after the national championship (NAIA 'Postseason' poll; AVCA DII December 'Final').

When sources disagree on a release date by 1-2 days (release page vs. PDF/xlsx vs. headline), the LATEST date is used so a ranking is never applied to a game played before the poll was published; each case is described in the poll's notes.

Week labels: Preseason, Week N (N-th regular-season poll by release date), Final Regular Season (NAIA) / Final (AVCA regular-season last poll), Postseason Final. Source labels that differ are recorded in notes.
Season = the fall season year. The 2020 seasons of both divisions were played in spring 2021 (release dates in 2021).
